subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the outfit shown in <Picture 1>: a nude skin-tone beige seamless fine-brushed fitted base-layer top with short capped sleeves that cover the shoulders, a rounded wide scoop neckline, a subtle V-shaped seam across the upper chest, light built-in shoulder pads giving a clean straight shoulder line, and a fitted body-skimming cut; the fabric is smooth, thick, fully opaque and non-sheer (completely not see-through), and lies smooth, flat and even against the body with no bumps and no outline. It is paired with black elastic-waist loose draped shorts. The nude beige color, capped sleeves, scoop neckline, V-shaped chest seam, shoulder-pad straight shoulder line, smooth seamless texture, and fabric opacity must be preserved exactly.
<Subject 2> is the young, attractive East Asian woman wearing <Subject 1>. Her hairstyle and facial features are not fixed and may be arranged in a natural, fresh everyday way; she has a slim natural build and a calm, elegant, effortless demeanor, with a look that differs from the model in <Picture 1>.
<Picture 1> is the costume reference image that fixes the nude beige color, capped-sleeve scoop neck, smooth seamless brushed texture, V-shaped chest seam, straight padded shoulder line, opaque fabric fit, and the fitted cut.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 10-second fashion home-wear lookbook clip of <Subject 2> wearing the exact outfit from <Subject 1>, with the costume guided by <Picture 1>. It cuts between a modern living-room corner with a light wood bookshelf, a feature wall and a low media console, and a calm bedroom corner with a bedside table and a table lamp, with multiple shot sizes and simple camera moves, showing the top through varied front-facing posing without ever turning to show the back.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the nude beige capped-sleeve scoop-neck smooth seamless base-layer top, its thick opaque non-sheer fabric, the smooth flat fitted front with no bumps and no outline, the V-shaped upper-chest seam, the straight padded shoulder line, and the black elastic-waist loose shorts are preserved in color, cut, and fabric; only the wearer's look is changed.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): partially_preserved - the outfit and elegant front-facing top-show demeanor from <Picture 1> are kept, while the wearer is changed to a young East Asian woman with naturally arranged hair and features rather than the reference model's exact look.
<Picture 1> (costume reference): fully_preserved - used solely to lock the garment style, color, texture, and fit; no text, logos, badges, arrows, or graphics from the reference image appear in the target video.

detailed_description:
The target video is a clean, high-definition fashion home-wear lookbook with ordinary cool-neutral daytime lighting, no warm golden tones, no subtitles, no on-screen text, and no icons. The nude-beige top fabric is thick, fully opaque and non-sheer, completely not see-through against skin, and lies smooth and flat against the body with a clean even surface, no bumps and no outline on the chest, no nipple shape and no body contour showing through; her hands stay away from the front of the garment and rest only on the shoulders, sleeves, hair, or waist.
[Shot 1] A medium shot opens in the modern living room, with a light wood bookshelf, a clean feature wall and a low media console softly out of focus behind her. <Subject 2> stands facing the camera, wearing <Subject 1>, rests one hand lightly on the edge of the low media console and lets the other hang naturally, her shoulders relaxed, to show the capped sleeves and the straight padded shoulder line. The camera performs a small sideways track from her left toward a near-front angle.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.200, the shot cuts to a medium close-up in the bedroom, with a bedside table and a table lamp softly blurred behind her. <Subject 2> raises one hand to tuck a strand of hair behind her ear and the other hand lightly smooths the capped sleeve on her left shoulder, keeping both hands well away from the front of the garment. The camera slowly dollies in a short distance, emphasizing the smooth seamless texture and the perfectly opaque flat front of the top.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, the shot cuts to a closer medium shot back in the living room, this time beside the light wood bookshelf. <Subject 2> rests one hand on the bookshelf side, her body turned three-quarters toward the camera, and gives a calm, natural look to the lens. The camera holds a steady, slight push-in, keeping the front of the top, the V-shaped chest seam, and the capped sleeves in frame.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.200, the shot cuts to a medium shot in the bedroom bedside corner. <Subject 2> faces forward and raises both hands to lightly smooth her hair back from her temples, showing the capped sleeves and the smooth seamless texture, then lets her hands fall to her waistline. The camera performs a slow small arc from her left to a near-front angle.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.200, the shot cuts to a closer upper-body shot near a plain light wall. <Subject 2> stands relaxed, shoulders down, both hands resting gently at her waistline, looking calmly into the lens to show the clean rounded neckline, the smooth seamless texture, the straight padded shoulder line, and the smooth, opaque, flat, even fit of the top with absolutely no bumps and no outline on the chest. The camera drifts slowly to a very slight low-angle close-up and holds until the end.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet daytime indoor home ambience throughout, with faint soft room tone and a gentle distant city daytime hum; no dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A light, upbeat, clean fashion lookbook instrumental at a moderate tempo, featuring a soft electronic pulse and gentle synth plucks, neutral and unobtrusive, no warm swelling strings.
